item.title: TTT 428: Hot Moms
item.description: This is a weird episode. What was originally planned as an entirely Bill Nighy themed episode changed once everyone started dying on us. Thanks David Bowie and Alan Rickman! We rolled with the punches and added more stuff about weirdly sexual kids songs on YouTube. Eric checks with Rachelle if seeing something less innocent in these videos makes him a total pervert or if there’s something more nefarious going on.
